decisions.reason: An illuminated candle arch close to the core Erzgebirge-style range has a long seasonal shelf life and was featured on the home page.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is a classic core product that traditional workshops usually keep in the catalogue for many years.
The firm presented the music box line as a flagship and it works as a platform for further disc editions, though it is distant from the core craft and so riskier.
This themed edition depends on licensed song content and already had a second edition, so it may be replaced, but it still adds variety to the music box platform.
The Christmas-themed platform fits the firm's seasonal focus and can be sold again each Christmas, though specific motif editions tend to rotate.
A Dresden-themed pyramid builds on the established offer and appeals to collectors, so it is likely to stay in the range.
